summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; no tests or repository code were run, and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, four cells per indent level, max_width passed unchanged) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py makes Align constrain its wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), adds Align.__repr__, and adds the public VerticalCenter class with newline-only vertical padding, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into renderable collection. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased and adds an Added subheading with the two entries, keeping the markdown entry. tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gain the requested tests and imports. Still unverified: the test suite has not been run, and the VerticalCenter render test depends on how Console(height=6) behaves when width is unset, so run pytest on tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py to confirm.
